plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both Parties at one month of Fees 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims in 21.3 and is far below a meaningful cap — likely deviation. Check 21.2/21.3 carve-outs and 21.4 savings language when assessing materiality.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-gives indemnity (20.1) covering 'every claim relating in any way' to our use; no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears. Note the cross-reference in 9.3 to 'Section 20.5', which does not exist in the outline.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month, worldwide, all-product non-compete on Customer — walk-away territory. Sec 12.3 states no such commitment was made, so flag the direct conflict and delete 12.4.
Sec 2.2 (first of two provisions numbered 2.2) makes Vendor our sole and exclusive analytics provider — deviation. Sec 12.3 disclaims exclusivity and supports removal.
No MFN obligation on Customer appears; sec 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Confirm nothing in the fee sections (7.1, 8.3) creates a hidden MFN before marking absent.
No non-solicit binding Customer located; sec 12.3 preserves hiring of anyone responding to general recruitment and disclaims a no-hire commitment. Beneficial to us — do not flag.

Sec 9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refunds and denies Vendor a matching right — compliant. Note the tension with the take-or-pay lock-in in 2.1, but address that under MINCOMMIT to avoid double-flagging.
Sec 8.2 gives a 30-day non-renewal window plus a 60-day Vendor reminder with deadline extension; sec 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice — appears compliant.
New York law and exclusive New York County courts, no foreign arbitration — within accepted list. Sec 28.3 executive escalation carve-outs preserve urgent relief.
Sec 24.1 permits Customer assignment to Affiliates/successors without consent; 24.2 restricts Vendor; 24.4 bars Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control — compliant and favourable.

Sec 14.1 confirms Customer owns Customer Data and pre-existing IP; 14.2 assigns Deliverables to Customer on payment; 14.3/13.2 handle embedded Vendor Technology. Check 15.1 no-training/no-sale restriction as support.

Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only, non-transferable licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excludes Affiliates and contractors — deviation. Sec 13.2/13.3 cover only paid-up/embedded material and constrain revocation, so cite them as the drafting model.
Sec 22.1 limits audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' notice, off-site where practicable; 22.2 puts cost on Vendor absent a >5% shortfall — compliant.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer identified; 9.4 expressly avoids termination penalties and 7.3 bars interest on amounts not due. Verify the take-or-pay in 2.1 is treated under MINCOMMIT rather than as an LD.

Sec 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to 15 days with no correction or refund thereafter — likely deviation on duration. Sec 19.1/19.3 warranties and the 19.4 repair-or-refund remedy are otherwise adequate.
Sec 18.1 sets CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O and USD 5m cyber coverage; 18.2 adds certificates and non-limitation language — present and compliant.

Sec 2.1 imposes USD 2m/year take-or-pay for three years 'without reduction or termination rights' — deviation. Reconcile with the 9.4 convenience right and the 12.3 disclaimer of minimum-volume commitments.

Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — deviation that contradicts 11.2/11.3 return and certified-deletion mechanics; propose deleting or subordinating 11.1.
